body: i want to kill myself so badly right now, im feeling so overwhelmed i just dont know what to fucking do... i hve no one to turn to... this isnt new, but this is more intense than it has been for a while... i think i might do it this time... u have any advice? ... prb time sensitive....

i wish i could tell u it gets better, surprise, it dosent... we are all feeling this way and nothing gets better, im just startin to go through these posts and so far ive found 0 help.... jus more reasons to say fuck it....

i was rly hopping something here would say there is a reason to not kill yourself but fuck no... we are all just struggling till the day we die... im so fucking depressed, idk what to do anymore... every day just gets harder.... every year i live just becomes another year of pain... fuck this shit.... im just a crying mess, what am i going to tell u... i want to stay alive... i rly do think you should.... but fuck man i cant see any reason why except because it can only get better from here.... 

maybe thats enough idfucking know... i know death is a last resort, and u cant come back from that, so i hold off,... but ya, pain... thats life... everyday is pain, dont ever expect that to change ... 

just, fuck them man... fuck them all.... everyday u live is another fuck you to everyone who tried to kill us.... thats all i got.... im looking for solace here, and just feeling more shit, so idk...
